{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The Empire landed troops and built barracks. Then, after they had more weapons than we did, they took over the city and the mountain and began shipping our people off like cattle.|[[Sartok]]|<ref name="The First to Strike">{{DoD|The First to Strike}}</ref>}}
'''Cattle''' was a plural noun used to describe domesticated animals owned as property.
For example, the [[derlac]]s of [[Shaum Hii/Legends|Shaum Hii]] were sold in noisy '''cattle markets.''' The [[Nazren]] compared to the way the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers treated them as being treated like cattle.

Animals known as '''variform cattle''' (perhaps related to [[variform bean]]s) were found in pens of the [[Danga estate]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]].
